remarks: EAST NORWALK GEM! This perfectly located 2-bedroom is right down the road from Calf Pasture Beach, easily accessible to everything SoNo nightlife has to offer, and walkable to the train station for an ideal commute. The main level is flooded with natural light, and includes an eat-in kitchen, a large master bedroom with tons of closet space, a second bedroom across the hall, and a recently updated bathroom with a subway tile shower and high end porcelain tile flooring. The MASSIVE upstairs loft is perfect for a home office or entertaining guests! To top it all off, Heat and Hot Water are included in the rent! No pets, excellent credit required.
